== Summary ==
The Players Committee's blank fillable tournament decklist sheet. It has 60 numbered card lines and a separate Additional Cards area. This upload preserves the publisher's native PDF and its form fields.

<ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Decklist-II-fill.pdf Decklist-II-fill.pdf], Star Wars CCG Players Committee, 2017.</ref>
